findings: Complete current MDX SHA-256 is 68064436d1077d53af8cf88ef66f56175a8385ab82f56436164b6a2891003679; all 4 declared sources passed current HTTPS access review.

The official plan PDF was retrieved at 971,223 bytes with SHA-256 c95d84641a0d024c04b9d8ba491e5972085b29a05a9aba4038128d78e8e12d01; it is unencrypted, has no JavaScript, and contains 75 physical pages.

Physical page 54 limits the section to utility, railroad, and pipeline operating property excluding land plus related personal property and improvements, describes the appraisals as retrospective, and states a January 1 effective date.

Physical page 56 says all pipelines receive an RCNLD model in which replacement cost depends on location, length, diameter, and composition and physical, functional, and economic depreciation are deducted.

Physical page 57 says a unit-value model may also be used when appropriate income statements and balance sheets are available, generally for regulated common carriers, and describes whole-system reconciliation and component allocation.

Physical page 58 separates appraisal-district land responsibility and says specified model indicators are reduced by land value to isolate improvements, personal property, and other operating property; physical page 59 states sales-review limitations.
Current official Comptroller sources support only the bounded local-appraisal, January 1, and general-method context stated in the article.
